sections.content: Use the future tense and ir a + infinitive to discuss career plans and intentions. The future presents a prediction or planned future action, while ir a + infinitive commonly presents a more immediate intention.

items.spanish: El año que viene buscaré un trabajo nuevo.
items.english: Next year I will look for a new job.
I am going to change careers.
I want to work in research.

sections.content: Use a time expression to make the future reference clear.
